'''Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited (IREDA)''' is an Indian [[Public sector undertakings|public sector]] enterprise which provides financial assistance and other services to projects related to [[Renewable energy|renewable sources of energy]] and [[Efficient energy use|energy efficiency]]/[[Energy conservation|conservation]]. Formed in 1987, IREDA is a Navratna organisation owned by the [[Government of India]] and administratively controlled by the [[Ministry of New and Renewable Energy]] (MNRE).<ref>{{Cite web |title=IREDA granted Navratna Status by DPE. |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/ireda-gets-navratna-status-what-it-means-renewable-psu-share-price-19403111.htm}}</ref>

In November 2023, IREDA went [[Public company|public]] with an [[initial public offering]] (IPO), listing on NSE and BSE.<ref name="ipo"/>

In July 2024, shares of Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) surged the Rs 300 level for the first time, with the stock touching a record high of Rs 304.50 on the NSE.

== Operations ==

Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited<ref>{{cite web |last1=vishal |first1=Raval |title=ireda-share-price-target-2025-a-comprehensive-analysis |url=https://www.bestnewsreport.com/ |website=bestnewsreport.com |access-date=19 July 2024}}</ref> is a Public Limited Government Company and a Non-Banking Financial Institution<ref name="ir5">{{cite news |title=IREDA signs MOU with TANGEDCO in Green Energy projects |url=https://newsonair.com/2021/09/08/ireda-signs-mou-with-tangedco-in-green-energy-projects/ |access-date=17 April 2022 |publisher=NewsOnAIR |date=8 September 2021}}</ref>  formed with the objective of promoting, developing and extending financial assistance  for setting up projects relating to new and renewable sources of energy and energy efficiency/conservation.<ref name="ir1">{{cite news |title=IREDA Registers All-Time High Half-Yearly PAT |url=https://orissadiary.com/ireda-registers-all-time-high-half-yearly-pat/ |access-date=9 April 2022 |publisher=Odisha News {{!}} Odisha Breaking News {{!}} Latest Odisha News |date=13 November 2021}}</ref> It is under the administrative control of Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).<ref name="ir2">{{cite news |title=Cabinet approves Rs 1,500 crore infusion in IREDA to boost renewable energy financing |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/economy/cabinet-decisions-january-19-key-announcements-anurag-thakur-rs-1500-crore-infusion-ireda-7731688/ |access-date=9 April 2022 |publisher=The Indian Express |date=19 January 2022 |language=en}}</ref>

On 26 April 2024, IREDA was granted "Navratna" status by the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE).<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 April 2024 |title=IREDA spurts after achieving Navratna status |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/ireda-spurts-after-achieving-navratna-status-124042900346_1.html |website=Business Standard}}</ref>

== Objectives and policies ==

* Financing renewable energy projects.<ref name="ir4">{{cite news |title=IREDA eyes Rs 2,749 cr revenue in 2021-22 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/renewables/ireda-eyes-rs-2749-cr-revenue-in-2021-22/articleshow/89591300.cms |access-date=17 April 2022 |publisher=The Economic Times |date=15 February 2022}}</ref>
* Supporting green power capacity.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Team |first=ThePrint |date=2024-04-18 |title=IREDA sets up office in GIFT City to support green hydrogen and renewable energy projects |url=https://theprint.in/india/governance/ireda-sets-up-office-in-gift-city-to-support-green-hydrogen-and-renewable-energy-projects/2047004/ |access-date=2024-05-25 |website=ThePrint |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Financing the setting up of solar manufacturing units.<ref name="ir7">{{cite news |title=IREDA calls solar module manufacturing bids under PLI scheme |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/energy/ireda-calls-solar-module-manufacturing-bids-under-pli-scheme-11623413952508.html |access-date=17 April 2022 |publisher=mint |date=11 June 2021 |language=en}}</ref>
* Encourage the use of renewable energy to foster sustainable growth.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IREDA holds Strategic Meet, outlines plans for Business Expansion and Cost Reduction |url=https://pib.gov.in/pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2002051 |access-date=2024-02-03 |website=pib.gov.in |language=en}}</ref>
